rule: Required columns are present and amounts are plain decimals with two places, positive, no symbols.
account_type is asset, liability, equity, revenue or expense.

normal_balance matches the type (debit for assets and expenses, credit for the rest), unless the account is a contra account named as one (accumulated depreciation, draws, returns, discounts, allowance).
The account number is in the range this spec gives its type.
Each entry's debits equal its credits.
Each line has a debit or a credit and not both.
Each entry has at least two lines and one date.
Every account used exists in the chart of accounts.
No posting to an inactive account or to a parent account that has sub-accounts.
Entry dates fall inside the period being checked.
Each row has a balance in debit or credit and not both; every account is in the chart.
Opening trial balance plus the journal equals the closing trial balance for every account.
An account's balance is on its normal side (cash isn't a credit, accounts payable isn't a debit).
Assets equal liabilities plus equity plus net income (revenue less expenses) for the period.
No two entries share the same date
column5: accounts and amounts (a likely double posting).
